title: Great practice
content: On arrived the experience reminded us to how practices used be run you arrived and awaited your turn in the surgery everyone was friendly and helpful and my problem was sorted it was my first visit to this type of practice only wish there was more of them thank you
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
